items: CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.6): Flags Off $2.27Bn Bakassi Deep Seaport with Tinubu, Joins World Bank AI Bootcamp & Audits 53,000+ Payroll
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 9.4): EXCO Approves Over ₦4.04Bn Across Rural Water, ₦570M UNICEF Nutrition Fund, Health & Majia University
OGUN STATE (PSI 9.2): Breaks Ground on $1.8Bn Lee Group First Industrial Park to Host 29 Factories & Create 26,000 Jobs
SOKOTO STATE (PSI 9.1): Awards ₦5.5Bn 33kV Power Contract to End 10-Year Blackout in 4 LGAs & ₦1.59Bn for 38 Health Facilities
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.9): Readies 800-Seat BPO Centre, P-SAC Security Hub & 50 Hybrid Buses for Tinubu Commissioning; Partners NSCDC
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 8.8): Tinubu Commissions 8.05km Ring Road 3; Gov. Eno Targets 1,000 More Compassionate Homes & Gifts Car to Orphan Bride
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.7): Completes ₦8.2Bn Kabala–Costain to Aliyu Makama Road Dualisation & Anti-Flood Bridge Extension
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Otti Commissions 12.6km Obingwa–Ukwa East Roads with Solar Streetlight Directive & Hosts IGP Disu
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.4): Launches 11-Day Diaspora Mega Medical Mission Across 7 Communities & Debunks ₦700M Billboard Rumour
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.3): Sponsors 5 Medical Staff for Cardiac Surgery Traineeship, Probes UNN Tragedy & Clarifies ₦150M Ad Policy
KATSINA STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. Radda Graduates 1,008 National Forest Guards as All Highways Reopen Across Katsina
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.0): ODCHC Records 22,000+ Safe Deliveries & 100,000+ Enrollees; State Enforces Zero-Tolerance on School Cultism
NIGER STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Bago Allocates 100 Hectares in Minna to Construct Modern Film City & Creative Hub
OYO STATE (PSI 7.6): Commences Property Owner Verification for Segment II of Ibadan Circular Road Compensation
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.4): Gov. Lawal Approves 282 New Senior Special Assistants to Deepen Grassroots & Disability Inclusion
IMO STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Uzodimma Delivers Maiden Keynote at Lagos Country Club Policy Dialogue on Grassroots Economies
TARABA STATE (PSI 7.0): University of Uyo Confers Honorary Doctor of Humane Letters on Gov. Agbu Kefas

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.6): President Tinubu (represented by VP Shettima) and Gov. Bassey Otu flagged off the 20m-draft Bakassi Deep Seaport ($2.27bn initial PPP funding); Cross River was selected by the World Bank for the South Korea AI GovTech Bootcamp; HoS and audit institutions uncovered 600+ duplicate pension accounts during digital verification; and UNICROSS procured two industrial laser cutters.

JIGAWA (PSI 9.4): Gov. Umar Namadi's EXCO approved ₦907.2m (RUWASA) and ₦280.5m (STOWA) for water projects across 23 constituencies, ₦299.3m Q1 BHCPF for 278 PHCs, ₦570m UNICEF malnutrition matching fund, ₦690.8m for Kazaure Livestock Centre, ₦432.87m for Kazaure Skills Centre, ₦863.63m for Majia Medical University quarters/labs, plus Farmer Registry and Cooperative frameworks.

OGUN (PSI 9.2): Gov. Dapo Abiodun conducted the groundbreaking ceremony and blueprint unveiling for the 450-hectare, $1.8 billion Lee Group First Industrial Park designed for 29 factories across footwear, leather, food processing, and recycling.

SOKOTO (PSI 9.1): Sokoto EXCO awarded a ₦5.5bn contract to restore 33kV electricity to Binji, Tangaza, Gudu, and Silame LGAs after a 10-year blackout, approved ₦988.9m to rehabilitate Government Technical College Binji, and earmarked ₦1.59bn to renovate 7 PHCs, Isa General Hospital, upgrade Sanyinna PHC, and solarize 30 PHCs.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.9): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang inspected the 800-seat Business Process Outsourcing Centre (projected for 2,400 youth jobs), the intelligence-driven Plateau Special Activity Centre, and 50 hybrid Jet Mover buses ahead of President Tinubu's Nov 14 commissioning, while partnering with NSCDC to protect dams and power towers.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 8.8): President Bola Tinubu commissioned the 8.05km Bola Ahmed Tinubu Ring Road 3 across Uyo, Ikono, and Ibiono Ibom LGAs; Gov. Umo Eno unveiled plans for 1,000 more Compassionate Homes per ward under ARISE 2.0 (2027–2031) and gifted a new car and ₦5m to a civil servant bride raised in the state orphanage.

KADUNA (PSI 8.7): Gov. Uba Sani's administration completed the 2.7km Kabala–Costain to Aliyu Makama Road Dualisation and Bridge Extension via CCECC after investing ₦8.2bn (₦2.2bn arrears plus ₦6bn fresh funding) and redesigning sharp curves and bridge spans to prevent flooding.

ABIA (PSI 8.5): Gov. Alex Otti commissioned the 12.6km Ohanze–Ntighauzo–Umuoha–Obete–Akirikaobu and Nkpokpu Opere–Obete–Isiala roads across Obingwa and Ukwa East LGAs, ordering immediate solar streetlight installation, and hosted Inspector-General of Police Olatunji Disu in Nvosi.

LAGOS (PSI 8.4): Lagos State and Eko Club International commenced an 11-day free Mega Medical Mission (Nov 14–24) across 7 communities including surgical screenings at LASUTH, while Information Commissioner Gbenga Omotoso debunked false claims of a ₦700m billboard fee, clarifying LASAA's ₦7m one-off practitioner registration.

ENUGU (PSI 8.3): Enugu sponsored 5 medical personnel for cardiothoracic surgery training at Babcock University Teaching Hospital; Gov. Peter Mbah ordered a probe into four UNN student deaths and proposed banning sign-out parties; and clarified that the ₦150m political ad fee applies equally to all parties.

KATSINA (PSI 8.2): Gov. Dikko Radda reviewed the passing-out parade of 1,008 newly trained National Forest Guards (including 18 women) to work alongside the Katsina Community Watch Corps, reporting that all state roads, markets, and farms have reopened.

ONDO (PSI 8.0): Ondo State Contributory Health Commission (ODCHC) reported facilitating 22,000+ deliveries and covering 100,000+ workers, 5,000+ retirees, and 82,000+ vulnerable residents across 84 accredited hospitals, while the Education Ministry launched a zero-tolerance anti-cultism campaign in secondary schools.

NIGER (PSI 7.8): Gov. Mohammed Umaru Bago announced the allocation of 100 hectares of land in Minna to build a private-sector-supported Film City equipped with state-of-the-art studios and a hotel during a meeting with Kannywood stakeholders.

OYO (PSI 7.6): Oyo State Government scheduled the free verification of property owners along Segment II of the Ibadan Circular Road (Badeku Village to Moniya-Iseyin Road) ahead of compensation payouts, warning residents against fraudulent intermediaries.

ZAMFARA (PSI 7.4): Gov. Dauda Lawal approved the appointment and upgrade of 282 Senior Special Assistants covering grassroots mobilization, community engagement, media, and disability inclusion under the Rescue and Rebuild Agenda.

IMO (PSI 7.2): Gov. Hope Uzodimma delivered the maiden keynote address at the Lagos Country Club Policy Dialogue themed 'The Future is Local: Stimulating Grassroots Economies for Inclusive Growth,' advocating economic decentralization and PPP models.

TARABA (PSI 7.0): The University of Uyo conferred an honorary Doctor of Humane Letters (D.H.L.) on Gov. Agbu Kefas (received by SSG Chief G.T. Kataps) during its 31st and 32nd Combined Convocation Ceremony in recognition of his public service and governance.
